Plot spatial cell boundaries

Source: R/SpatialCellPlot.R
SpatialCellPlot.Rd

Plot cell segmentation polygons from a boundary table or Seurat spatial image.

Usage

SpatialCellPlot(
  object = NULL,
  res = NULL,
  boundaries = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  image = NULL,
  crop = TRUE,
  group.by = NULL,
  features = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  palcolor = NULL,
  fill.alpha = 0.7,
  boundary.color = "grey30",
  boundary.linewidth = 0.1,
  theme_use = "theme_spatial",
  theme_args = list(),
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  combine = TRUE,
  nrow = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  byrow = TRUE,
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.direction = "vertical",
  legend.title = NULL,
  boundary = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  image.scale = c("lowres", "hires"),
  overlay_image = TRUE,
  image.alpha = 1,
  flip.y = NULL,
  pt.size = 1,
  molecules = NULL,
  mols.size = 0.1,
  mols.alpha = 1,
  mols.colors = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

Optional `Seurat` object used to extract boundaries or values.

res

Optional result list containing a `boundaries` data frame.

boundaries

Optional boundary data frame.

cells

Optional cell or spot identifiers to retain.

image

Seurat image name. Multi-image objects require an explicit name.

crop

Whether to crop the plot to the selected boundaries.

group.by

Boundary column or Seurat metadata column used for filling.

features

Features to display. Multiple features return a patchwork.

palette, palcolor

Palette name or explicit colors. The default uses `"Paired"` for categories and sequential `"YlGnBu"` for numeric values. Named colors are matched to category names.

fill.alpha

Polygon fill opacity.

boundary.color, boundary.linewidth

Boundary appearance.

theme_use, theme_args

Theme used to style the plot. Default is `"theme_spatial"`.

assay

Assay used when `features` are fetched from `object`.

layer

Layer used when `features` are fetched from `object`.

combine

Return combined panels, or a named list when `FALSE`.

nrow, ncol, byrow

Layout controls for multiple feature panels.

legend.position, legend.direction, legend.title

Legend controls.

boundary

Boundary name in the image. `NULL` selects segmentation when available and otherwise plots centroids. Explicit names must exist.

xlim, ylim

Optional increasing ROI limits in raw coordinate units. Cells are selected by centroids; boundary vertices are clipped at the limits.

image.scale, overlay_image, image.alpha

Raster scale, visibility, and opacity.

flip.y

Reverse the y axis. `NULL` uses the official FOV orientation; use `FALSE` for the historical FOV layout. Visium rasters include the flip.

pt.size

Centroid point size.

molecules

Optional names of already loaded molecules to overlay. No files are read. Molecules are filtered by ROI, not assigned to cells.

mols.size, mols.alpha, mols.colors

Molecule size, opacity, and optional named colors matched to molecule names.

...

Arguments passed to other functions.

Value

A `ggplot`, patchwork, or named list of plots.

Details

Boundary tables require `cell_id`, `x`, and `y` columns in polygon vertex order, with optional `polygon_id` and `ring_id` columns for multipart cells and holes. Object-derived boundaries use the same display transform as [SpatialSpotPlot()]. ROI filtering does not subset the input object.

Examples

# Constructed polygons demonstrate plotting, not a segmentation algorithm.
boundaries <- data.frame(
  cell_id = rep(c("cell1", "cell2"), each = 4),
  x = c(0, 2, 2, 0, 3, 5, 5, 3), y = rep(c(0, 0, 1, 1), 2),
  cell_type = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 4)
)
SpatialCellPlot(boundaries = boundaries, group.by = "cell_type")
